# netbird

A NetBird control plane: management, signal, dashboard and its identity setup.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dashboardVersion | string | `"v2.16.0"` | The dashboard, which is versioned separately from the server.  Pinned rather than `main`, which is what netbird's own compose files use: a lab is reproducible or it is not.  |
| namespace | string | `"netbird"` | Namespace the control plane runs in. |
| registry | string | `"docker.io"` | Registry every netbird image is pulled from. |
| storage | string | `"1Gi"` | Size of the volume management's sqlite store lives on.  The whole mesh is in it: peers, keys, groups and policies. Losing it is losing every peer's registration.  |
| subdomain | string | `"netbird"` | Label the mesh answers on, inside the gateway's zone.  One hostname for all four backends, routed by path — see the header. A peer, a browser and the relay all reach `<subdomain>.<zone>`, so there is one name to match the wildcard certificate and one for a human to remember.  |
| version | string | `"0.60.2"` | Version of management, signal and relay, which ship as one release.  The relay protocol and the management config schema change together across releases, so these three are one number and not three.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | [API_GATEWAY](../signatures/API_GATEWAY.md) | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| generation | [SECRET_GENERATION](../signatures/SECRET_GENERATION.md) | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| identityOperator | [IDENTITY_OPERATOR](../signatures/IDENTITY_OPERATOR.md) | The identity operator's CRDs are established, so its CRs can be applied. |
| oidc | [OIDC_PROVIDER](../signatures/OIDC_PROVIDER.md) | An OIDC issuer, its endpoints, and the CR a consumer registers a client with. |
| trust | [TRUST_BUNDLE](../signatures/TRUST_BUNDLE.md) | A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mesh | [MESH_NETWORK](../signatures/MESH_NETWORK.md) | A mesh control plane, addressed from inside the cluster running it and from outside. |
| meshAdmin | [MESH_ADMIN](../signatures/MESH_ADMIN.md) | The credential that administers the mesh, as a Secret only its own cluster can read. |
| route | [ROUTE_CLAIM](../signatures/ROUTE_CLAIM.md) | A public hostname this floe publishes, for whoever answers for the zone. |
